quotes.text: My first question goes to Dr. Isbell. And I want to know what role have universities played in the development of the AI Risk Management Framework? And more broadly, how are universities helping to shape the future of AI by engaging in public-private partnerships, Dr. Isbell?

Ms. Tabassi, to your knowledge, has the People's Republic of China developed a similar tool to the AI Risk Management Framework? [...] what role if any has NIST played in sharing findings and the best practices with the international community, particularly our allies?
